**In one line**: Consumer trust in generative AI has slipped below 40%, yet people still rely on AI advice when making product decisions, according to McKinsey.

### Key points
- A McKinsey survey puts consumer trust in generative AI at under 40%.
- Despite the low trust, consumers reportedly still lean on AI recommendations to guide product choices and purchases.
- The findings highlight a widening gap between how much users trust AI and how much they actually use it.

### Why it matters
That shoppers act on AI advice without fully trusting it suggests companies should pair AI recommendation features with transparency and verification safeguards. The trust gap remains a challenge for both regulators and marketers.
